S01: A year ago, Sir Gawain gave his word — and now the day had come to keep it.
S02: The knight walked alone through the mist, with his own will toward his destiny.
S03: He was a little uneasy, but he showed no fear.
S04: About his waist, tied fast, he wore the girdle that shielded him from all danger.
S05: A year earlier, this same opponent had brought him this challenge.
S06: Before him, out of the mist, rose the Green Chapel.
S07: Gawain slowed his step, but did not stop.
S08: His fingers tightened on the sword's hilt.
S09: The chapel was old and silently stern.
S10: He stepped onto the empty green before the door.
S12: From within the Green Chapel came the lord of the castle.
S13: His bearing was calm, and commanding.
S14: The two faced each other in silence.
S15: Lord: "You have kept your word. Now kneel and await my sword!"
S17: He knelt on the cold ground.
S20: The first stroke descended toward his neck.
S23: The lord raised the sword again.
S24: The second stroke was even more resolute.
S26: The blade stopped only a few centimeters from his neck.
S27: Then it swung a third time.
S28: The knight was only slightly wounded.
S29: A little blood flowed, but he remained on his feet.
S30: Gawain leaped up, ready to fight.
S31: But the opponent did not attack — he smiled.
S32: Lord: "Morgan le Fay, Arthur's half-sister, devised this challenge."
S33: Lord: "You proved yourself brave, and so as a reward I gave you this green girdle that belonged to me."
S34: The girdle passed from hand to hand.
S44: He told him everything, even the moment of fear.
S46: Arthur: "That moment of weakness was your strength!"
S47: Tomorrow, all knights will wear the green girdle.
S48: In memory of this adventure, the green girdle remained forever.
